row: F39#21 bug: flat untextured grey plane in the foreground of the Venn aftermath frame (tidewake__fight__venn__resolve__aftermath, about 142 s)
head: bdee5774901cf8ec946863735d0d172e1e086f74
_why: CPU cannot produce this frame: on llvmpipe the aftermath draw lands about 6.5 s after the win, past the 6 s reward hold, so the capture's same-receipt check rejects it ('aftermath state invalid after draw'; reproduced twice on main d9d79ff9 and 4af7d07a). The win frame on CPU shows no grey plane. Needed back: the aftermath and receipt-expired PNGs plus manifest.json (camera/player poses) so the plane can be identified and fixed as a bug.
